paragraphs.text: A street tree lives on average half as long as the same species in a park. Salt, heat from walls and compacted soil under the pavement all shorten its life.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Cities have started planting in trenches rather than single pits, so that roots of several trees share a run of loose soil under the kerb. Survival after five years has roughly doubled where this was done.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Species choice matters as much as soil. Narrow streets need trees whose crowns stay small, and near shops owners object to species that drop sticky fruit on parked cars.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Residents rarely oppose planting, but they often object to watering restrictions in dry summers, when young trees need more water than lawns.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: Salt, heat from walls and compacted soil under the pavement all shorten its life

explanation.en: Salt, heat and compacted soil are why street trees die early → i.
explanation.kk: Тұз, қабырғадан шыққан ыстық және тығыздалған топырақ — ағаштың қысқа өмірінің себебі → i.
explanation.ru: Соль, жар от стен и уплотнённая почва — причины короткой жизни дерева → i.

items.quote: planting in trenches rather than single pits

explanation.en: Planting in trenches instead of pits is a better way to plant → ii.
explanation.kk: Шұңқырдың орнына траншеяға отырғызу — жақсырақ отырғызу тәсілі → ii.
explanation.ru: Посадка в траншеи вместо ям — способ сажать лучше → ii.

items.quote: Species choice matters as much as soil.

explanation.en: The paragraph is about choosing species: narrow streets, sticky fruit → iii.
explanation.kk: Абзац түрді таңдау туралы: тар көше, жабысқақ жеміс → iii.
explanation.ru: Абзац о выборе породы: узкие улицы, липкие плоды → iii.

items.quote: they often object to watering restrictions in dry summers

explanation.en: Watering in dry summers and the neighbours’ objections → iv.
explanation.kk: Құрғақ жаздағы суару және тұрғындардың қарсылығы → iv.
explanation.ru: Полив в засушливое лето и возражения жителей → iv.
